payload.body: Molt-matts a258ad0 (molt-vc, contract T5): ~/.local/bin is now first on PATH in every new interactive shell on rhadamanth, so a bare `utilz` and every Utilz command there resolve to hv's dev links into ~/Devel/prj/Utilz, ahead of brew's 2.14.2. Running shells keep their old PATH until restarted. A run that reaches utilz by PATH, rather than through its own tree's bin/, now gets the primary's main, not brew: name the tree's bin/ explicitly in any script or slot. UTILZ_INSTALL_PREFIX through Molt's env writer is still to come.
